people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
translations.bsb: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put of thine honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
